description: This file defines commands and an action structure for executing commands related to Android CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device). It includes command interfaces, specific command implementations for starting, stopping, removing, powering wash and powering on devices, as well as an executable action that runs these commands asynchronously and manages operation lifecycle.
